'''Stephen Gano West''' (born 1946)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://psy.fsu.edu/php/about/history/gallery/west.html |title=Stephen G. West |website=Florida State University |access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref> is an American [[quantitative psychology|quantitative psychologist]] and professor of psychology at [[Arizona State University]]. He was the [[editor-in-chief]] of the ''[[Journal of Personality]]'' from 1986 to 1991, of ''[[Psychological Methods]]''  from 2001 to 2007,<ref name=cv>{{Cite web |url=http://jenni.uchicago.edu/Spencer_Conference/CVs%202010/West_cv.pdf |title=Stephen G. West Curriculum Vitae |access-date=2018-11-08}}</ref> and of ''[[Multivariate Behavioral Research]]'' in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://smep.org/general-information/administration |title=Administration  |website=SMEP |access-date=2018-11-08}}</ref> He was also the president of the [[Society of Multivariate Experimental Psychology]] from 2007 to 2008. He was educated at [[Cornell University]] and the [[University of Texas at Austin]], and received the [[Society for Personality and Social Psychology]]'s Murray Award in 2000.<ref name=cv/>
